title: pi-subagent configuration
description: Global or project-local configuration for the pi-subagent extension.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema.

agentScope.description: Select user definitions, project definitions, or user definitions followed by project overrides.

maxDepth.description: Absolute delegation depth. A top-level Pi session has depth 0.

runtimeMode.description: Single execution mode. foreground waits for every child's final answer and exposes no lifecycle tools; background starts continuable mailbox-v2 children that return a readable path plus durable id.

maxConcurrentBackgroundRuns.description: Maximum number of continuable subagent turns that may execute concurrently within one extension runtime.

maxIdleRuntimes.description: Maximum settled continuable child runtimes retained in the process-wide idle LRU. Zero unloads immediately.

inheritExtensions.description: Load the parent's other Pi extensions in child runtimes. pi-subagent itself is filtered out and explicit agent tool ceilings still apply.

openAIIdentity.description: Inject the pi-codex-minimal-tools identity lifecycle as a named inline extension for OpenAI Responses child models.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum child output inserted into a parent tool result, report, or completion update.
